_comment: Closed list of facts the obligations can test. tests/test_fact_registry.py fails if an obligation uses a fact that is missing here.

facts.question: Is your organisation regulated by the RBI (for example a bank or an NBFC)?
Do you onboard customers through video-based identification (V-CIP)?
Do you onboard customers without meeting them face to face (for example through an app)?
Do you verify customers using Aadhaar XML or a secure QR code?
Do you rely on a third party to carry out customer due diligence for you?
Is your company listed on a stock exchange (SEBI-listed)?
Is your company listed on an SME exchange or SME platform?
Is your company among the top 2000 listed companies by market capitalisation?
Has your company issued equity shares with superior voting rights (SR shares)?
Is the chairperson of your board a non-executive director?
Is the chairperson a promoter, or related to a promoter?
What is your paid-up equity capital?
What is your net worth?
Are you required to have a Risk Management Committee?
Is the director in question a non-executive director?
How old is the director in question?
Is the customer an individual person?
Is the customer a company?
Is the customer a trust?
Is the customer an unincorporated association or body of individuals?
Is this an account for a foreign student?
What is the foreign student's nationality?
Is this a 'small account' as defined in the KYC Master Direction?
Is this a savings account of a Self Help Group (SHG)?
Was this account opened using OTP-based e-KYC?
Is the customer a politically exposed person?
What risk category has the customer been given?
Is the customer unable to complete the process because of illness or infirmity?
Has the customer changed their address?
Is address verification still pending for the customer?
Has the customer failed to submit a PAN or Form 60?
Were you unable to complete customer due diligence for this customer?
Would continuing due diligence tip the customer off about a suspicious transaction report?
Has a suspicious transaction report (STR) been filed on this customer?
Was the customer being prompted or coached during the video call?
Is this a walk-in customer (not an account holder)?
What percentage of equity does the shareholder hold?
What percentage of the company does the shareholder own?
What percentage of the body does the member own?
What percentage of the trust's interest does the beneficiary hold?
What is the transaction amount?
Is this an international money transfer for someone who is not an account holder?
How many working days old is the Aadhaar document?
